title: On Striking the bell three times
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：strike　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strike 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the guide ① struck the bell three times year after year, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② strikes the bell three times for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ strike the bell three times at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ struck the bell three times before — a line in the guidebook for July 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Striking the bell three times year after year, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ strike for a shorter working week for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Strike for a shorter working week at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ strikes for a shorter working week year after year every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ struck the bell three times again when nobody else would.

⑩ To strike the bell three times, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody strikes the bell three times for the whole place again and somebody must strike the bell three times year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打（一般过去式 struck the bell three times：1962 年向导头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 打（一般现在 strikes the bell three times：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打（不定式 to strike the bell three times：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打（过去完成时 had struck the bell three times：1956 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打（动名词 striking the bell three times 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 罢工（strike for a shorter working week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去罢工为缩短每周工时而罢工）
G. v. 罢工（strike for a shorter working week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 strikes for a shorter working week，而母亲又一次 struck the bell three times）

items.q: to strike the bell three times
struck the bell three times before
strike for a shorter working week for the whole place
strike for a shorter working week at once
strikes for a shorter working week year after year
struck the bell three times again
to strike the bell three times

answers.why: strike 意为“打”，1962 年向导年年地打把那口钟敲了三下，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 struck。
strike 意为“打”，自那以后向导替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 strikes。
strike 意为“打”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打把那口钟敲了三下”，此处为不定式 to strike the bell three times。
strike 意为“打”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人打过，故用过去完成时 had struck。
strike 意为“打”，向导说“打把那口钟敲了三下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 striking the bell three times 作主语。
strike 意为“罢工”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去罢工为缩短每周工时而罢工”，should ever 之后用原形 strike for a shorter working week。
strike 意为“罢工”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻罢工为缩短每周工时而罢工（strike for a shorter working week at once），以后再也不要提起。
strike 意为“打”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例罢工为缩短每周工时而罢工，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 strikes。
strike 意为“打”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地打把那口钟敲了三下，用一般过去式 struck 叙述。
strike 意为“打”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要打把那口钟敲了三下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，向导年年地打把那口钟敲了三下；山谷里每一个旅人都说这是头一回。（struck the bell three times）
多年以后，向导仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（strikes the bell three times）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯打把那口钟敲了三下这件事本身。（to strike the bell three times）
早在 1956 年就有人打把那口钟敲了三下，七月那天旅行手册上的一行字就是证据。（had struck the bell three times）
向导说过，年年地打把那口钟敲了三下这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（striking the bell three times 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻罢工为缩短每周工时而罢工，以后再也不要提起。（strike for a shorter working week，祈使句）
answers: In 1962 the guide struck the bell three times year after year, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the guide still strikes the bell three times for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to strike the bell three times at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had struck the bell three times long before 1969, and the line in the guidebook for July proves it.
Striking the bell three times year after year, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Strike for a shorter working week at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 strike 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the guide struck the bell three times year after year, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide strikes the bell three times for the whole place whenever the valley asks.
Striking the bell three times year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever strike for a shorter working week for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley strikes for a shorter working week year after year every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother struck the bell three times again, and the valley remembered that half.
